name: Dumbbell shoulder press

phases.name: lockout
phases.cue: Arms long, biceps by your ears

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Elbows under the wrists, core tight

formTips: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width and your core braced
Start with the dumbbells just above your shoulders, elbows under your wrists
Press straight up until your arms are long and the dumbbells are over your shoulders
Lower slowly back to shoulder height
Keep your ribs down so your lower back doesn't arch
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to push the weight up
Letting the elbows drift far forward or behind the wrists
Bouncing the dumbbells off the shoulders
